svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Block 140 long, 44 wide, bore 20 along the bottom, top shaped to the stabiliser's lower skin.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: A slot in the top takes the fin root through the stabiliser's centre.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Split clamp under the bore with one M4 bolt; stabiliser and fin bond to it with epoxy.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Square the stabiliser to the wing by eye from behind before the epoxy sets.
